title: Pages the person chose
description: The report pages a person chose to build from, recorded after the report was fetched (run.yml cannot change once a run has started). A2 reads it and keeps only those pages' units, plus the supporting pages they drill through to or show as tooltips. `all: true` (or no record at all) builds every page.

pages.description: The page names as the person gave them. Matched to the report's pages without regard to case, quotes or runs of spaces, underscores or hyphens.

all.description: Every page: nothing is filtered. `pages` is then empty.
